mode.name: Header Buttons
mode.hint: Show sheet header buttons as a ribbon, or collapse them into a dropdown. Right-clicking the sheet always opens the menu (shift + right-click for the browser menu).

macros.name: Menu Macros
macros.hint: Macro UUIDs to add to the right-click menu, one per line or comma separated. Each runs as macro({ app: ActorSheet | ItemSheet, document: Actor | Item, item: Item | null, actor: Actor | null, token: TokenDocument | null }).

itemMacros.name: Item Menu Macros
itemMacros.hint: Macro UUIDs to add to the item section shown when right-clicking an item on an actor sheet. Each runs as macro({ app: ItemSheet, document: Item, item: Item, actor: Actor, token: TokenDocument | null }).
